stories.title: Fort Temiscamingue: Where the Cedars Dance at the Narrows

originalReview.notes: The exact 1876 McLaughlin Qualla original shows the long gabled building in the shore-side group. Parks Canada identifies a trade store in that southwestern sector. The identified diorama supplies an approximate scale and alignment.
